defs.def: a painting, drawing or photograph of a person, especially of the head and shoulders 肖像；半身画像；半身照

ex.s: a portrait photograph of proper proportion
He painted this self-portrait about 400 years ago.
ex.t: 他大约在400年前画了这幅自画像。

ex.s: Throughout his life, he made over 90 self-portraits!
ex.t: 在他的一生中，他画了超过90幅自画像！

ex.s: His many self-portraits provide us with a visual autobiography.
ex.t: 他的众多自画像为我们提供了一部视觉自传。

defs.def: a detailed description of sb/sth 详细的描述；描绘

ex.s: But winning gold in Rio paints the most vivid portrait of the team's competitive spirit.
ex.t: 但在里约夺金最生动地描绘了这支队伍的竞技精神。

ex.s: But winning gold in Rio paints the most vivid portrait of the team’s competitive spirit.
ex.t: 但在里约夺金最生动地描绘了这支队伍的竞技精神。
